newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - TIG cut by J.P. Morgan.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - TIG cut by J.P. Morgan.

text.p: -- J.P. Morgan said analyst James English cut his rating on TIG Holdings Inc to long-term buy from buy after the company reported disappointing first quarter earnings.
-- English also cut his 1997 year-end price target to $33 a share from $35. He cut his 1997 estimate to $2.69 a share from $2.90 and cut his 1998 estimate to $2.90 from $3.10.
-- Said first quarter expenses exceeded expectations by about $7.8 million, or $0.09 a share.
-- Projects 1997 share repurchases at 4.8 million, of which 1.4 million were bought in the first quarter.
